name: crittr
description: CRITTR — six critters, a meadow, and other people. Web (Next.js), world server (Node + ws + SQLite) and contracts (Hardhat). Three independent packages; this file only delegates.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix contracts install
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
